source_caption:
🎬 All Rise (2019–2023)

All Rise follows the personal and professional lives of judges, prosecutors, public defenders, and courtroom employees working within the busy Los Angeles County justice system, where every case brings difficult decisions, emotional confrontations, and unexpected challenges. At the center of the story is Lola Carmichael, a passionate and determined former deputy district attorney who becomes a newly appointed judge and sets out to bring fairness, compassion, and integrity to her courtroom. Refusing to blindly follow tradition, Lola frequently challenges established procedures while attempting to ensure that everyone who enters her courtroom receives justice. Alongside her close friend and fellow legal professional Mark Callan, as well as a dedicated group of attorneys and courthouse staff, she navigates complicated criminal cases, workplace rivalries, political pressure, and personal relationships. From emotional trials and shocking legal revelations to ethical dilemmas, family struggles, and unexpected romantic complications, the characters constantly face situations that test their beliefs and professional responsibilities. As Lola grows into her position, she discovers that making the right decision is rarely simple, especially when the law and personal morality collide. Combining compelling courtroom drama, emotional storytelling, complex relationships, and thought-provoking legal conflicts, the series explores justice, equality, friendship, ambition, responsibility, and the challenges of maintaining integrity within the legal system.

🎭 Genre: Legal Drama • Crime • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: 42–45 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Greg Spottiswood

📺 Where to Watch: Check Hulu, Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, and Fandango at Home for current streaming or digital purchase availability. Availability varies by region.

source_details.synopsis: All Rise is an American legal drama television series created and developed by Greg Spottiswood for CBS and later the Oprah Winfrey Network. It aired from September 23, 2019, to November 18, 2023. In May 2021, the series was canceled by CBS after two seasons before being picked up for a third season by the Oprah Winfrey Network (OWN) that September. The third season premiered on June 7, 2022. In August 2023, it was announced that the third season would be its final season. The series finale aired on November 18, 2023.
